_meta.description: Static per-model price table for computing estimated AI assistant cost from chat_runs.metadata token counts (input_tokens/output_tokens). Not wired into any code yet — this is data only.
notes: Prices change over time and are not fetched live — re-verify against each provider's official pricing page before relying on this for real billing/cost reporting.
pricing_available: false means no per-token rate exists to compute cost from; leave cost as null/unknown for that model rather than guessing.
OpenRouter model ids ending in ':free' are $0 by OpenRouter's own naming convention for that routing variant, but free-tier availability/rate limits can change or be withdrawn.

groq/compound.note: Groq Compound is an agentic system, not a single model — it bills the underlying model(s) it selects at their own per-token rates plus separate charges for the server-side tools it invokes (web search, code execution, etc.). There is no single flat per-token rate for it.

qwen/qwen3.8-27b.note: As of 2026-08-28, Qwen3.8-27B's hosted API pricing has not been published yet (Qwen's own model card lists its managed Cloud endpoint as 'coming soon'). Do not confuse with the older, already-priced 'qwen/qwen3.6-27b' ($0.60 input / $3.00 output per million tokens on Groq) — that is a different model id.

ornith:9b.note: Ollama runs locally/self-hosted (see OLLAMA_BASE_URL in .env) — there is no per-token API charge. Real cost is your own compute/electricity, not something derivable from a per-token rate, so $0 here means 'not billed per token', not 'free to run'.
